CloudConfig:
#cloud-config
packages:
  - nginx
  - curl
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable nginx
  - systemctl start nginx
  - echo "Packer build completed successfully!" > /var/log/build-complete.log
users:
  - name: demo
    groups: sudo
    shell: /bin/bash
    sudo: ['ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL']
    ssh-authorized-keys:
      - ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQDemoKeyForDemoUser
